{{Dialogue|Kintaka and Latara|line1=no|"[gasp and groan]"|The creature|line2=no|"[exclaims]"|Kintaka and Latara|Wicket!|attr=Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka and Latara, as the creature is startled by Wicket Wystri Warrick|audio=WicketScaresAnUmbrella-Ewoks.flac|src=<ref name="Season Scepter" />}}
An '''umbrella-like creature''' lived on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. The creature had two long, [[Color/Legends|purple]] [[Limb/Legends|legs]], each of which sported a [[Claw/Legends|clawed]], two-toed foot. The creature's head, which held two white [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] with black pupils, was wide like an [[Umbrella/Legends|umbrella]] and bore stripes that alternated blue and red.<ref name="Season Scepter" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date note">{{EwoksDate|appearance of the [[Umbrella/Legends|umbrella]]-like [[Species/Legends|creature]]|[[The Season Scepter]]}}</ref> the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]] and [[Latara/Legends|Latara]] used the creature, who wore yellow shorts, as a source of shade while they rested on the [[Beach/Legends|beach]] of a [[Unidentified Endor pond|pond]] near a [[Forest/Legends|forest]] on Endor. However, when Kintaka and Latara's friend [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] leaped into the otherwise still [[Water/Legends|water]], he splashed them and the creature. Startled, the creature let out a shriek before retreating into the forest as Latara and Kintaka chided Warrick.<ref name="Season Scepter" />

==Behind the scenes==
The unidentified creature appeared in "[[The Season Scepter]],"<ref name="Season Scepter" /> the thirteenth episode in the [[Ewoks: Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']]. The episode was written by [[Bob Carrau]] and premiered on [[November 1]], [[1986]].<ref name="Insider 27">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>
